findings.title: Zero-production districts in bottom-5 routing
findings.description: computeRoutingData uses sorted.slice(-5) from all 30 districts. For narrow crops, districts with production=0 always occupy the bottom slice, producing routing rows for districts that never grow the selected crop. Fix: filter production > 0 before slicing, or add a status column distinguishing 'not grown here' from 'undersupplied'.

findings.title: Prediction chart Tooltip formatter never fires for yield
findings.description: The Tooltip formatter checks `name === 'Yield ×100'` but the recharts `name` parameter is the dataKey ('Current' or 'Projected'), not the metric label. The condition is never true, so yield always displays as the raw ×100 integer (e.g. 847) instead of 8.47 t/ha. Fix: use a secondary Y-axis for yield, or show yield as a stat card outside the grouped BarChart.

findings.title: Prediction chart Yield ×100 encoding confuses users
findings.description: Yield is multiplied by 100 to plot on the same axis as production and area. Even if the tooltip were fixed, the bar labeled 'Yield ×100' displaying 847 while the tooltip says 8.47 t/ha will confuse reviewers. Use a dedicated stat card or secondary axis for yield.

findings.title: Opportunity Finder filter-count double computation
findings.description: Each filter button calls cards.filter(...).length inline in JSX on every render. Derive counts into a useMemo map keyed by tag.
